column1: # Keep one row for every screen/state in docs/legacy-functional-inventory.md.
# runtime_owner: framework that renders the ordinary reachable route today.
# accepted requires ordinary-route wiring, required behavior, relevant tests, and >=90% visual similarity.

column7: note
SwiftUI shell and pager exist but authenticated root still presents LegacyApplicationView.
SwiftUI footer exists but is not on the authenticated route.
No complete SwiftUI account dropdown is integrated.
Ordinary logged-out route is SwiftUI; live login and >=90% visual gate are not yet accepted.

MiAuth uses persistent WebKit website data for ordinary login/retry/relaunch; destructive instance-data clearing is explicit-only. Manual Preview E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
Native SwiftUI feed family exists but authenticated root still uses UIKit.
Tap/swipe pager exists but is not wired to the persisted tab configuration on the ordinary route.
Search feed support exists; the complete user/list/search contract is not wired.
SwiftUI refreshable implementation exists but is not on the ordinary route.
The typed notification-note route now renders native SwiftUI variants; production data and the full visual matrix remain unaccepted.
Native MFM rendering covers the migrated note route, while the complete legacy grammar and visual matrix remain under migration.
Native CW disclosure is wired on the migrated note route; full visual acceptance remains.
Native attachment grids and media paging are exercised through the ordinary route; live-media and full visual acceptance remain.
Native preview loading, cached-card failure presentation, retry, and link callbacks are wired; live-network and full visual acceptance remain.
Native poll rendering and repository-backed voting are wired; live-server and full visual acceptance remain.
Native reaction picker and retryable repository mutations run through the ordinary detail route; live-server and full visual acceptance remain.
Native reply, quote, and renote workflows are connected end to end; live posting and full visual acceptance remain.
Native own/other overflow menus invoke favorite, link, delete, and mute callbacks; live-server and full visual acceptance remain.
NotificationMessageBridge.note now reaches the typed native thread without a fixture root; authenticated production and full visual acceptance remain.
Native detail actions execute through the ordinary notification route; authenticated production and full visual acceptance remain.
Native SwiftUI trends are integrated through the ordinary Home page-zero route; UIKit remains only at the pager hosting boundary.
Native SwiftUI note and user search are integrated with tap/swipe result tabs and typed destinations; UIKit remains only at the pager hosting boundary.
The ordinary user-search route now hosts SwiftUI; authenticated E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
The ordinary profile route now hosts SwiftUI; live account behavior and visual parity remain unaccepted.
Followers, following, and relationship navigation are native SwiftUI; live E2E and visual gates remain.
Profile editing is reachable through the SwiftUI profile route; camera/upload E2E and visual gates remain.
Native compose modes exist but the ordinary app route still presents UIKit.
Native media workflow exists but is not wired or E2E accepted.
Native controls exist but are not wired or E2E accepted.
SwiftUI poll support exists; location remains outside the accepted legacy contract and the route is unwired.
The ordinary Notifications tab now hosts native SwiftUI paging, realtime, retry, account switching, row routing, and tap-again scroll-to-top; authenticated E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
Foreground and tapped pushes now enter the account-filtered SwiftUI store and typed user/note routes without logging payloads; device push E2E and visual gates remain.

The ordinary Messages tab now hosts native SwiftUI history and capability-gated current/legacy adapters; misskey.io currently publishes neither complete DM endpoint family, and authenticated E2E/visual gates remain.
Native conversation navigation, paging, send/retry/cancel, mention/hashtag/URL routing, and keyboard-safe UI are wired; server capability, authenticated E2E, and >=90% visual gates remain.
Native add/switch/delete/profile routes passed clean-install E2E plus unmasked account, empty, and retry-state visual gates.
The ordinary settings route and typed SwiftUI navigation stack passed live interaction E2E and the unmasked visual gate.
Tab editing and Light/Dark/accent persistence passed unit/E2E coverage and unmasked changed-pixel plus SSIM gates.
Instance selection, add/delete/reorder, picker, compatible persistence, and the reachable legacy shortcut passed unit/E2E and unmasked visual gates.
The native list, typed full-text detail route, and back navigation passed E2E and both unmasked visual gates.
The recovered gradient, geometry, animation, profile links, and version presentation passed E2E and unmasked visual gates.
No ordinary route uses the orphan account/theme controllers, but UIKit remains the conservative owner until the storyboard and source are physically retired after authenticated-root cutover.
Reusable native empty/error/banner presentation is integrated for Accounts/Settings, while remaining legacy surfaces still own the app-wide placeholder contract.
Principal content is SwiftUI behind a required extension host; E2E and >=90% visual gates remain.
